verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਛ ਕਛ ਬਗ ਹੰਸ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਪਾਖਾਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਖੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਉਦਧਿ ਸੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise machh kachh bag ha(n)s mukataa paakhaan a(n)mirat bikhai pragaas udhadh sai jaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: As the marine dependent life like fish, tortoise, heron, swan, pearls precious stones and nectar is known to be related to water (like, sea etc.)

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਾਰੋ ਤਾਰੀ ਤਉ ਆਰਸੀ ਸਨਾਹ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਲੋਹ ਏਕ ਸੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਰਚਨਾ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise taaro taaree tau aarasee sanaeh sasatr loh ek se anek rachanaa bakhaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as a lock, key, sword, armour jacket and other weapons are made from the same iron,

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਂਜਨ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਹੋਤ ਏਕ ਮ੍ਰਿਤਕਾ ਸੈ ਖੀਰ ਨੀਰ ਬਿੰਜਨਾਦਿ ਅਉਖਧਿ ਸਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: bhaa(n)jan bibidh jaise hot ek mritakaa sai kheer neer bi(n)janaadh aaukhadh samaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as many type of earthenware are made from the clay in which milk, water, eatables and medicines are stored;

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਰਨ ਆਸ੍ਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸਕਲ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤ ਕੀ ਸਾਖਾ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੩੭੫॥
verses.translit_en: taise dharasan bahu baran aasram dharam sakal girahasat kee saakhaa unamaaneeaai ||375||

en.bdb: Similarly, many forms of philosophical tomes, the four caste system, the four abodes of life and religions are known as the branches of the household life. (They all are there because of the household life).  (375)
